unmet: RQADR-4: The `## Enforced by` section in ADR-005 covers §1's acquire and release statements but omits §1's statement about refused behavior — "the engine emits `pipeline.refused.claimed`, prints the holder string, and returns non-zero without dispatching any stage." `DSCLA-3` (in `claim-coordinator-unit-test.sh`, which covers non-zero exit, no stage dispatched, and event emitted on a claimed issue) and `DSCLA-9` (in `teardown-repeat-signal-test.sh`, which covers the refused run outputting the holder string) both enforce that statement but are not listed. The section lists the teardown test with only `[DSCLA-1]`, `[DSCLA-5]`, `[DSCLA-6]`, `[DSCLA-7]`, and lists the unit test only under §2. — docs/adr/ADR-005-claim-coordinator.md | - §1 (engine calls claim after admission lock, before first stage; release on every EXIT path) →

findings.text: The issue requires this and the change does not meet it: RQADR-4: The `## Enforced by` section in ADR-005 covers §1's acquire and release statements but omits §1's statement about refused behavior — "the engine emits `pipeline.refused.claimed`, prints the holder string, and returns non-zero without dispatching any stage." `DSCLA-3` (in `claim-coordinator-unit-test.sh`, which covers non-zero exit, no stage dispatched, and event emitted on a claimed issue) and `DSCLA-9` (in `teardown-repeat-signal-test.sh`, which covers the refused run outputting the holder string) both enforce that statement but are not listed. The section lists the teardown test with only `[DSCLA-1]`, `[DSCLA-5]`, `[DSCLA-6]`, `[DSCLA-7]`, and lists the unit test only under §2. — docs/adr/ADR-005-claim-coordinator.md | - §1 (engine calls claim after admission lock, before first stage; release on every EXIT path) →. What would settle it: a change that meets this requirement in full.

The change does this and no requirement asks for it: The change amends ADR-059 §4 with a new behavioral statement about cross-machine exclusion but the ## Enforced by section lists no test for it — only the prior §2/§4 amendment entry — so CLAUDE.md's rule "A new or changed statement ships with its test in the same PR" is unmet for ADR-059: No issue requirement asks for an Enforced by entry in ADR-059 for the new §4 cross-machine statement; RQADR-5 covers only that the text amendment is made — docs/adr/ADR-059-issue-vs-run-keying.md | - §2/§4 amendment 2026-11-14 (#2541: a tree git no longer lists is reclaimed, under the lock and age guards) → `tests/unit/cleanup-forgotten-trees-test.sh` G1–G5. What would settle it: the change without this part, or a requirement that asks for it.
